And here's a pic of my Short Ryder, just started flowering a few days ago. I think I planted this one about a week or two after the Pandora. This is my first time growing autos, and I'll tell you what, I'm not impressed at all. Tiny, scrawny, and realllllly short veggers. I didn't write down when i planted them, but it must have been 1-2 months ago? I will say one thing for them though, they are ridiculously easy to grow. I might just do something like a vertical pvc strawberry planter (scroll all the way down) next time with 4-6 plants.

Soil for both of them was a mix of 70% FFOF and 30% of the following: earthworm castings, extra perlite, black cinders, bit of dolomite, and a scoop of native soil from the backyard. I also fed them weekly with 5-1-1 fish emulsion during veg, bi-weekly kelp solution for micros, and weekly 0-10-10 hydroponic stuff once they started flowering.
